emails.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
emails.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost drivers behind it; we appreciate this transparency as a basis for a fair, stable agreement. Please review whether a modest adjustment within your approval authority, or flexibility on payment terms, would be possible in light of the cost changes outlined. We are happy to work through this step by step in the spirit of our partnership.

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed +6.2% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C241@2026-02, idx:PPI-C241@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 358.56, payment_days 14, index_clause None; unit_price 359.83, payment_days 30, index_clause None; unit_price 361.03, payment_days 45, index_clause None). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
